title: Arithmetic Pipeline Evaluator
spec: Create a math evaluation module. Define individual functions for addition, subtraction, multiplication, division, floor division, modulo, exponentiation, and negation. Each takes the appropriate numbers and returns the result. Then write an entry function `process(start, commands)` that accepts a starting number and a sequence of tuples containing an operation name and a value. It should use a mapping to route each command to the correct function and return the final computed number. For example given five and a sequence of multiply by two, subtract three, and square, it returns forty nine.

title: String Cleaning Pipeline
spec: Build a text normalization utility by defining distinct functions for various text transformations. You need separate functions to convert to lowercase, remove punctuation, strip whitespace, remove digits, collapse multiple spaces into one, reverse the string, extract vowels, and count characters. Create an entry function `normalize(text, configuration)` that applies all these transformations in a specific order if a corresponding flag is set in a given configuration list, returning the fully processed string. This modular approach ensures each text operation can be tested independently.

title: Measurement Conversion Suite
spec: Write a unit conversion module that provides standalone functions for common conversions. Implement separate functions for converting celsius to fahrenheit, fahrenheit to celsius, miles to kilometers, kilometers to miles, pounds to kilograms, kilograms to pounds, gallons to liters, and liters to gallons. Include an entry function `convert(requests)` that takes a list of triplets containing a value, a source unit, and a target unit. It should route each request to the correct conversion function and return a list of converted values rounded to two decimal places.

title: Descriptive Statistics Library
spec: Develop a statistics library. You must implement independent functions to calculate the mean, median, mode, variance, standard deviation, range, interquartile range, minimum, and maximum of a numerical list. After defining these mathematical operations, write an entry function `summarize(data)` that takes a list of numbers and returns a list containing the results of all nine calculations in the exact order listed. Example: passing a list from one to five will return a mean of three and a range of four among the other statistics.

title: Shape Property Calculator
spec: Build a geometry module calculating properties of two dimensional shapes. Create separate functions for the area of a square, area of a rectangle, area of a circle, area of a triangle, perimeter of a square, perimeter of a rectangle, circumference of a circle, and perimeter of a triangle. Then implement an entry function `measure(shapes)` that receives a list of shape descriptions with their dimensions. It must call the appropriate function for each shape to calculate its area and perimeter, returning a list of tuple results for each shape.

title: Sequence Aggregation Tools
spec: Implement a collection of sequence aggregation operations. Write distinct functions to find the sum of elements, the product of elements, the count of positive numbers, the count of negative numbers, the number of even integers, the number of odd integers, the maximum difference between adjacent elements, and the number of strictly increasing adjacent pairs. Create an entry function `aggregate(sequence)` that runs all these functions on a given list of integers and returns a tuple of the eight computed metrics.

title: Text Validation Rules
spec: Create a password or username validation system using independent rule functions. Define individual functions to check if a string has a minimum length of eight, contains an uppercase letter, contains a lowercase letter, contains a digit, contains a special symbol, has no spaces, does not start with a number, and does not repeat the same character three times consecutively. Write an entry function `validate(credential)` that runs the input through all these rule functions. It should return true only if all individual functions return true.

title: Grid Transformation Engine
spec: Develop a module for two dimensional grid transformations. Provide separate functions to flip a grid horizontally, flip it vertically, rotate it ninety degrees clockwise, rotate it ninety degrees counterclockwise, transpose it, invert all boolean values, extract the main diagonal, and extract the anti diagonal. Include an entry function `transform(grid, transformations)` that takes a boolean matrix and a sequence of transformation names. It applies each transformation sequentially using the dedicated functions and returns the final modified grid.

title: Date Arithmetic Utilities
spec: Create a toolkit for calendar calculations. Write individual functions to check if a year is a leap year, get the number of days in a month, calculate the day of the year, find the remaining days in the year, add a given number of days to a date, subtract days from a date, find the difference in days between two dates, and format a date as a string. Define an entry function `schedule(events)` that uses these helpers to process a list of event records, adjusting dates according to given offsets and returning a list of formatted new dates.

title: Financial Metric Calculators
spec: Build a finance module containing distinct functions for various calculations. Implement separate functions for simple interest, compound interest, continuous compound interest, present value, future value, return on investment, debt to equity ratio, and gross profit margin. Write an entry function `evaluate(portfolio, metric)` that takes financial data parameters and a target metric name, then invokes the correct mathematical function to compute and return the requested financial metric. Example: calculating simple interest for one hundred principal at five percent for two years returns ten.

title: Bitwise Operation Simulator
spec: Design a simulator for low level bit operations on eight bit integers. Implement individual functions for logical and, logical or, logical exclusive or, logical not, left shift, right shift, rotate left, and rotate right. Write an entry function `simulate(value, instructions)` that takes an initial integer and a list of operations with arguments. It should map the operation names to your functions, apply them sequentially to the integer while keeping the result within eight bits, and return the final integer value.

title: RGB Color Adjustments
spec: Implement a color manipulation library. Provide separate functions to invert a color, convert it to grayscale, boost the red channel, boost the green channel, boost the blue channel, decrease brightness, increase brightness, and calculate the complementary color. Each function takes a tuple of three integers representing red, green, and blue components. Write an entry function `adjust(pixels, operation)` that applies a specified adjustment operation to a list of color tuples, returning the new list of transformed colors.

title: Matrix Math Helpers
spec: Create a mathematical module for operations on two by two matrices. Define distinct functions to add two matrices, subtract two matrices, multiply a matrix by a scalar, multiply two matrices, find the transpose, calculate the trace, calculate the determinant, and find the inverse. Include an entry function `compute(matrices, operation)` that accepts two matrices and an operation command. It directs the inputs to the correct function and returns the resulting matrix or scalar value depending on the operation requested.

title: HTML Element Builder
spec: Build a simple markup generator. Write separate functions to generate standard markup for a heading, a paragraph, a bold text span, an italic text span, a hyperlink, an image, an unordered list, and a list item. Each function takes the inner text or source URL and returns the wrapped string. Create an entry function `render(elements)` that iterates over a list of element descriptions and their contents, using your functions to build and return a fully concatenated string of markup.

title: Markdown Block Converters
spec: Develop a text conversion module for basic markup. Define individual functions to parse bold text, parse italic text, parse inline code, parse blockquotes, parse unordered lists, parse ordered lists, parse horizontal rules, and parse links. Each function targets a specific syntax pattern and replaces it with an alternative format. Write an entry function `parse(document)` that passes the input string through all these conversion functions in sequence to produce a final formatted plain text string.

title: Rational Number Operations
spec: Create a library for rational number arithmetic. Write separate functions for finding the greatest common divisor, simplifying a fraction, adding two fractions, subtracting two fractions, multiplying two fractions, dividing two fractions, converting a fraction to a floating point number, and checking if two fractions are strictly equal. Define an entry function `calculate(expressions)` that processes a list of fraction operations. It evaluates each using the dedicated functions and returns a list of simplified fraction tuples.

title: Kinematics Formula Solver
spec: Implement a physics module with standalone functions for basic motion equations. Define functions to calculate average velocity, final velocity given time, displacement given time, acceleration given velocities, time given velocities and acceleration, kinetic energy, potential energy, and momentum. Create an entry function `solve(problems)` that accepts a list of physical scenarios, identifies the missing variable, and calls the appropriate formula function to return the numerical answer for each scenario.

title: File Path Utilities
spec: Build a module for handling file system paths as strings. Write individual functions to extract the directory name, extract the file name, extract the file extension, check if a path is absolute, join two path segments, normalize slashes, remove trailing slashes, and get the parent directory. Include an entry function `process(paths, operation)` that takes a list of raw path strings and applies a specified operation to all of them using your helper functions, returning the updated list of path strings.

title: Custom Text Encoders
spec: Design a module with several simple text encoding algorithms. Implement distinct functions for a basic caesar cipher, a reverse string cipher, an atbash cipher, a rot thirteen cipher, a vowel replacement cipher, a consonant capitalization cipher, a hex encoder, and a binary string encoder. Write an entry function `encode(messages, cipher)` that takes a list of strings and a cipher name. It must route the input to the corresponding encoding function and return a list of the transformed messages.

title: IPv4 Address Tools
spec: Create a utility for manipulating internet addresses represented as string literals. Define independent functions to check if an address is valid, check if it is private, check if it is loopback, extract the first octet, extract the last octet, convert the address to a thirty two bit integer, convert from an integer back to an address, and find the network class. Write an entry function `analyze(addresses)` that applies all these checks and conversions to a given list of addresses and returns the collected results.

title: Store Inventory Manager
spec: Develop a backend module for inventory state management. Implement individual functions to add new stock, remove stock, update a price, apply a discount percentage, calculate total inventory value, find the most expensive item, find out of stock items, and list items below a certain quantity threshold. Define an entry function `manage(inventory, actions)` that takes an initial inventory state and a sequence of modification commands. It applies the commands using the specific functions and returns the final state.

title: Tabletop Dice Scorer
spec: Build a scoring engine for a dice game. Write separate functions to score a pair, score a three of a kind, score a four of a kind, score a full house, score a small straight, score a large straight, score all dice summing to a target, and score a chance roll. Create an entry function `score(rolls, category)` that takes a list of five dice rolls and a requested category. It evaluates the dice using the requested scoring function and returns the integer score achieved.

title: Orbital Mechanics Helpers
spec: Implement an astronomy calculation suite. Provide distinct functions to calculate escape velocity, orbital velocity, gravitational force, orbital period, surface gravity, planetary density, kinetic energy of an orbit, and potential energy of an orbit. Each function uses standard physical constants. Write an entry function `compute(bodies, metric)` that takes a list of planetary data and computes a requested metric for each body using the appropriate function, returning a list of numerical results.

title: Culinary Recipe Scaler
spec: Create a module to adjust recipe proportions. Define separate functions to scale up ingredients, scale down ingredients, convert teaspoons to tablespoons, convert tablespoons to cups, convert cups to quarts, convert ounces to grams, convert pounds to kilograms, and calculate the total weight of a recipe. Write an entry function `adjust(recipe, factor)` that takes a list of ingredient amounts and a target scaling factor. It processes the list using the scaling and conversion functions to return updated measurements.

title: Polynomial Math Functions
spec: Develop a module for operations on polynomials represented as lists of coefficients. Implement independent functions to evaluate a polynomial at a given value, add two polynomials, subtract two polynomials, multiply a polynomial by a scalar, multiply two polynomials, find the derivative, find the indefinite integral, and find the degree of the polynomial. Include an entry function `evaluate(tasks)` that reads a list of operational commands on polynomials, calls the corresponding functions, and returns the resulting polynomials or values.

title: Shopping Cart Discount Engine
spec: Write an entry function `evaluate(cart)` that calculates the total discount for a shopping cart represented as a list of item prices. The logic must apply eight distinct discount rules, using a dedicated standalone function for each rule. The rules include a seasonal ten percent off, a loyalty five dollar flat reduction, a bulk discount of fifteen percent for carts over one hundred dollars, a clearance rule subtracting two dollars, an employee half off rule, a weekend discount of five percent, a first buyer bonus of ten dollars, and a holiday special taking off seven percent. The entry function should return a list of the discount amounts generated by each rule when applied independently to the cart total. For an initial cart total of two hundred dollars, the output is a list of eight calculated discount values.

title: Sound Wave Amplitude Modulators
spec: Implement a main function `modulate(signal)` that applies a series of independent amplitude transformations to a list of sound wave samples. To keep the math organized, write a specific module level helper function for each of the eight audio effects. The effects are shifting the signal up by ten, doubling the volume, halving the volume, applying a hard clipping limit at eighty, applying a soft floor at twenty, adding a constant white noise value of five, inverting the signal phase, and zeroing out any negative values. The main function must pass the original signal to each effect function independently and return a list of eight modified signal lists. For an input list of fifty and negative thirty, the output gathers the results from all eight transformations.

title: Text Symbol Categorizer
spec: Create an entry function `categorize(character)` that analyzes a single text symbol to determine its properties. The analysis must be performed by eight independent boolean functions defined at the module level, each checking a specific trait. The traits to check are whether the character is a vowel, a consonant, a digit, a whitespace symbol, a punctuation mark, an uppercase letter, a lowercase letter, and a mathematical operator like plus or minus. The main function returns a list of eight true or false values corresponding to these checks. For the character uppercase A, the output list begins with true for vowel, false for consonant, false for digit, and so on.

title: Coordinate Point Transformers
spec: Provide an entry function `transform(point)` that takes a two dimensional coordinate pair and applies eight separate geometric transformations to it. You must implement each transformation as a distinct standalone function. The transformations are translating by five on the horizontal axis, translating by negative three on the vertical axis, scaling uniformly by a factor of two, scaling down by half, reflecting across the horizontal axis, reflecting across the vertical axis, swapping the horizontal and vertical values, and projecting the point onto the horizontal axis by setting the vertical value to zero. The entry function gathers all eight resulting pairs into a single list and returns it.

title: Pet Feeding Schedule
spec: Develop a function `feed(weight)` that computes various food portion sizes in grams based on a dog's weight. The system must compute eight separate meal portions, each handled by its own standalone function defined outside the main logic. The portions are a morning meal multiplying weight by ten, an evening meal multiplying by twelve, a training treat allowance multiplying by two, a dental chew fixed at one, a weekend bonus adding fifty, a diet day subtracting twenty, a liquid intake multiplying by twenty, and a vitamin supplement fixed at five. The entry function runs each calculation on the dog weight and returns a list of the eight portion amounts.

title: Potion Brewing Times
spec: Write an entry function `brew(potency)` that takes a base potency integer and computes the brewing time in minutes for eight different magical potions. Implement each calculation as an individual module level helper function. The potions are a healing draft adding ten, a mana potion multiplying by two, a speed elixir squaring the potency, a strength serum adding fifty, a visibility brew subtracting five, a love charm multiplying by five, a sleep draught dividing by two, and a luck potion adding one hundred. The entry function must invoke all eight functions using the input value and return their results as a list of eight integers.

title: Character Status Modifier
spec: Implement a function `modify(health)` that takes an integer representing a character's current health points and computes eight different status effects. Each effect must be calculated by a dedicated standalone function. The required calculations are a poison effect reducing health by five, a burn effect reducing it by ten, a heal effect adding twenty, a max boost doubling the health, a curse halving the health, a doom effect setting health to one, a regen effect adding fifteen percent, and a shield effect adding a flat fifty points. The entry function should collect the results of these eight calculations into a list and return it. For an input of one hundred, the output returns a list containing ninety five, ninety, one hundred twenty, and so forth.

title: Smartphone Battery Estimators
spec: Create an entry function `estimate(charge)` that receives a battery percentage and computes eight different remaining time estimates in minutes. The logic must use eight separate standalone projection functions. The required calculations are a standby time multiplying charge by ten, a video playback time multiplying by two, a gaming time multiplying by one, a music time multiplying by five, a reading time multiplying by three, a navigation time multiplying by one point five, a call time multiplying by four, and an emergency mode multiplying by twenty. The entry function calls each and returns a list of eight numerical results.

title: Plant Growth Projectors
spec: Develop an entry function `project(height)` that checks a plant's height in centimeters and computes eight different growth stage indicators. Each indicator must be implemented as its own distinct module level function returning a boolean. The indicators are whether the height is greater than ten, less than five, exactly zero, an even number, a multiple of three, greater than fifty, between twenty and thirty, and less than one hundred. The main function applies all eight indicator functions to the plant height and returns a list of eight boolean results. For a height of twelve, the functions will evaluate its characteristics accordingly.

title: Text Capitalization Engine
spec: Write a main function `format(text)` that takes a simple lowercase sentence and applies eight distinct capitalization styles to it. You must organize the code by writing a separate standalone helper function for each style. The styles are converting the entire string to uppercase, capitalizing only the first letter, replacing spaces with underscores, removing all spaces, doubling every character, appending an exclamation mark, prepending a question mark, and repeating the entire string twice. The entry function runs all eight formatting functions on the input string and returns a list of the eight altered strings.

title: Gymnastics Routine Scorer
spec: Provide an entry function `score(difficulty)` that calculates the points for a gymnast based on their base difficulty rating. The input is a single integer representing the base difficulty. You must compute eight different scoring categories, each handled by its own standalone function. The categories are base execution adding ten, an artistic bonus multiplying by one point five, a time penalty subtracting two, a perfect landing bonus adding five, a stepping penalty subtracting one, a form deduction dividing by two, a combination bonus adding three, and a crowd appeal bonus adding four. The main function gathers the eight category scores into a list.

title: Harmonic Frequency Generator
spec: Create a function `harmonize(frequency)` that takes a fundamental pitch in hertz and calculates eight musical intervals above it. Each interval calculation must be written as a separate helper function defined at the module level. The intervals are a minor second multiplying by one point zero five nine, a major second multiplying by one point one two two, a minor third multiplying by one point one eight nine, a major third multiplying by one point two six, a perfect fourth multiplying by one point three three, a perfect fifth multiplying by one point five, a major sixth multiplying by one point six eight, and an octave multiplying by two. The main function returns a list of the eight calculated frequencies.

title: Fleet Rental Pricer
spec: Implement an entry function `quote(days)` that calculates eight different cost components for renting a car based on the number of days. Each cost component must be computed by its own distinct standalone function. The components are a base daily rate of forty, a daily insurance fee of fifteen, a flat cleaning fee of twenty, a daily gps tracker fee of five, a young driver surcharge of ten per day, a one time booking fee of fifteen, a daily toll pass fee of eight, and a final discount subtracting two for every day booked. The entry function gathers these eight individual charges into a list and returns it. For an input of three days, the base rate is one hundred twenty, insurance is forty five, and so on.

title: Access Right Evaluator
spec: Develop a function `inspect(code)` that takes an integer file permission code and determines eight different access rights. Each access right must be evaluated by a separate function that performs a mathematical check and returns a boolean. The checks are whether the code is greater than seven hundred, if the code is exactly seven seven seven, if it is an even number, if it is divisible by ten, if it is greater than four hundred, if it is less than two hundred, if it equals zero, and if it is a multiple of five. The main function applies all eight functions to the input code and returns a list of eight booleans.

title: Signal Timing Processor
spec: Write an entry function `time(seconds)` that takes an integer representing the current cycle time of a traffic intersection and computes eight different phase durations. You must structure the solution with an individual module level function for each phase calculation. The phases are adding ten for the main green phase, subtracting two for the yellow phase, adding fifteen for the red phase, multiplying by two for the pedestrian walk phase, dividing by two for the pedestrian flash phase, adding five for the protected turn phase, adding twenty for the night mode phase, and returning a fixed zero for the fault mode phase. The entry function returns a list of the eight phase durations.

title: Concrete Mix Proportions
spec: Provide an entry function `scale(cement)` that takes the amount of cement in a batch and calculates the required amounts for eight other construction materials. Each material calculation must be handled by its own standalone helper function. The calculations are sand as twice the cement, gravel as three times the cement, water as half the cement, ash as one tenth the cement, bonding agent as a flat five units, dye as a flat two units, retarder as one hundredth of the cement, and accelerator as one twentieth of the cement. The entry function evaluates all eight material amounts and returns them as a list.

title: Currency Exchange Engine
spec: Create a function `exchange(dollars)` that accepts an amount in dollars and calculates its equivalent in eight different fictional currencies. Implement each calculation as a separate dedicated function defined at the top level. The calculations are multiplying the dollars by three point seven for gold coins, by eight for silver pieces, by twenty for bronze tokens, by one point five for credits, by four for bottle caps, by ten for gems, by two for scrap metal, and by five for energy cells. The main function runs all eight exchange functions and returns a list of the results.

title: Board Distance Estimator
spec: Implement an entry function `estimate(squares)` that takes an integer representing the number of open squares in a straight line and calculates eight different movement metrics for board game pieces. Each metric must be implemented as its own standalone function. The metrics are the pawn single move which is always one, the pawn double move which is two if squares is greater than one else one, the knight hop which is a fixed three, the bishop reach multiplying squares by one point four, the rook reach equaling squares, the queen reach adding one to squares, the king move which is always one, and a custom piece reach multiplying squares by two. The entry function returns a list of the eight movement values.

title: Group Membership Filters
spec: Write a main function `filter(group)` that takes a list of integers and applies eight distinct filtering operations. Each filter must be defined as an independent standalone helper function. The operations are keeping only positive numbers, keeping only negative numbers, keeping only even numbers, keeping only odd numbers, keeping numbers greater than ten, keeping numbers less than zero, keeping numbers divisible by three, and keeping numbers divisible by five. The entry function applies all eight filter functions to the input group and returns a list containing the eight resulting filtered lists.

title: Signal Smoothing Tools
spec: Develop a function `process(series)` that takes a list of numerical data points and computes eight single value summary metrics from the sequence. Each metric must be computed by a separate dedicated module level function. The metrics are the first element, the last element, the difference between the last and first element, the sum of the first two elements, the sum of the last two elements, the absolute value of the first element, the middle element assuming an odd length, and the total length of the series. The entry function passes the series to all eight metric functions and returns a list of their numerical outputs.

title: Code Point Inspector
spec: Create an entry function `examine(value)` that takes an integer representing a unicode code point and runs eight numeric boundary checks. You must implement each check as a distinct helper function returning a boolean. The checks are whether the value is between sixty five and ninety inclusive, between ninety seven and one hundred twenty two inclusive, between forty eight and fifty seven inclusive, exactly thirty two, less than thirty two, greater than one hundred twenty seven, exactly nine, and exactly ten. The entry function uses all eight boundary check functions on the input value and returns a list of eight boolean results.

title: Snack Dispenser Logic
spec: Implement a main function `dispense(coins)` that takes an integer amount of inserted cents and calculates eight different vending outcomes. Each outcome must be handled by its own separate standalone function. The outcomes are the change remaining after buying a fifty cent item, the change after buying a seventy five cent item, the change after buying a one hundred cent item, a boolean indicating if a one hundred twenty cent item can be bought, the number of ten cent items that can be bought, the number of twenty five cent items that can be bought, the penalty fee of five cents deducted from the coins, and a bonus adding ten cents. The entry function collects these eight outcomes into a list.

title: Freight Cost Estimator
spec: Provide an entry function `calculate(weight)` that calculates eight different shipping rates based on a package weight in pounds. Each shipping rate must be computed using an independent module level helper function. The rates are a standard ground fee of two times the weight, an express air fee of five times the weight, a next day fee adding twenty to the air fee, a fragile handling fee of ten, a heavy surcharge of fifteen if the weight is over fifty else zero, a rural delivery fee of twelve, an international base fee of fifty, and a signature required fee of three. The main function returns a list of the eight calculated shipping costs.

title: Fitness Calorie Burners
spec: Write a function `burn(minutes)` that takes an integer of workout minutes and generates eight estimates of calories burned for different exercises. You must write a specific helper function for each exercise calculation. The exercises are running multiplying minutes by ten, walking multiplying by four, cycling multiplying by eight, swimming multiplying by nine, yoga multiplying by three, weightlifting multiplying by six, jumping rope multiplying by twelve, and rowing multiplying by seven. The entry function computes all eight values and returns them as a list.

title: Textile Shrinkage Estimators
spec: Create a main function `adjust(length)` that takes a single integer representing a fabric length in inches, and computes eight adjusted lengths after different washing conditions. Each adjustment must be implemented as its own standalone function. The adjustments are a cold wash subtracting one, a hot wash subtracting five, a tumble dry subtracting ten, a line dry keeping it the same, a bleach wash subtracting two, a heavy cycle subtracting eight, a delicate cycle subtracting three, and an iron press adding one. The entry function runs all eight adjustments on the input length and returns a list of the eight resulting fabric lengths.

title: Glaciology Ice Flow Metrics
spec: Implement a collection of separate functions to calculate the physical dynamics of a glacier. Define individual functions for basal sliding velocity, internal deformation rate, total ice velocity, ice flux, basal shear stress, accumulation rate, ablation rate, and mass balance. Finally, write a main function `glacier(measurements)` that accepts a list containing ice thickness, surface slope, ice density, gravity, temperature, snow depth, and meltwater volume in that order. This entry function should call all the individual metric functions and return a list of the eight calculated metrics. For example, given an input list of standard glaciological field observations, it should return a list of the corresponding calculated floats.

title: Hydrology Watershed Metrics
spec: Create a module with distinct functions for analyzing watershed hydrology. Write a separate function for each of the following calculations: drainage density, runoff coefficient, time of concentration, peak discharge, stream frequency, bifurcation ratio, form factor, and circularity ratio. Provide a primary function `watershed(basin)` that takes a list of topographic figures including basin area, total stream length, longest flow path, elevation difference, and number of stream segments. The function must call all the specialized helpers and return a list of the eight computed indicators. For example, an input list of geographic measurements should yield the eight respective hydrological ratios.

title: Chemical Solution Calculator
spec: Develop a suite of independent functions to determine the properties of a chemical solution. You must define separate functions to calculate molarity, molality, mass percentage, volume percentage, mole fraction of solute, mole fraction of solvent, parts per million, and parts per billion. Include a main function `solutions(data)` which receives a list of numerical values representing moles of solute, mass of solute in grams, volume of solute in milliliters, mass of solvent, volume of solution in liters, and total moles. It should execute each of the eight specific property functions and return a list of the results. Providing an input like two moles, fifty grams, twenty milliliters, one thousand grams, one and a half liters, and fifty total moles will return the eight concentration measurements.

title: Meteorology Atmospheric Indices
spec: Write a module consisting of individual functions to compute atmospheric stability and weather indices. You need a dedicated function for each of the following: lifted index, showalter index, k index, total totals index, convective available potential energy, convective inhibition, precipitable water, and bulk richardson number. Write an entry function `atmosphere(sounding)` that accepts a list of weather balloon data points such as temperature and dew point at various atmospheric pressure levels, and wind shear. It should use the individual formulas to return a list of the eight calculated instability values. A valid input list with ten respective numeric values should output a list of the eight meteorological figures.

title: Disease Outbreak Statistics
spec: Formulate a script with distinct functions to measure epidemiological data. Create a separate function for incidence rate, prevalence rate, point prevalence, period prevalence, case fatality rate, crude mortality rate, cause specific mortality rate, and proportional mortality ratio. Provide a central function `outbreak(population)` that takes a list of integers representing total population, new cases, existing cases, total deaths, deaths from the specific disease, and the time period multiplier. This function should call each rate calculator and return a list of the eight resulting percentages or rates. An input list of one hundred thousand people, five hundred new cases, two thousand existing cases, one thousand total deaths, and fifty disease deaths should produce the eight health statistics.

title: Solar Radiation Geometry
spec: Construct a script containing a series of separate functions to calculate angles and metrics for solar panels. Create individual functions for declination angle, hour angle, solar altitude angle, solar zenith angle, solar azimuth angle, surface azimuth angle, angle of incidence, and extraterrestrial radiation. Combine these by writing an entry function `solar(parameters)` that receives a list of values including the day of the year, local solar time, latitude, surface tilt, and surface azimuth. It should invoke all the individual geometry functions and return a list of the eight calculated solar metrics. Given an input of the eightieth day, twelve hours, forty degrees latitude, thirty degrees tilt, and zero azimuth, the output should be a list of the eight floating point results.

title: Tissue Biomechanics Calculator
spec: Build a collection of standalone functions to analyze the mechanical properties of biological tissues. You must write a distinct function for each metric: axial stress, axial strain, youngs modulus, shear stress, shear strain, shear modulus, poissons ratio, and yield strength. Then, write a main function `biomechanics(measurements)` that accepts a list of physical measurements including applied force, cross sectional area, original length, change in length, shear force, lateral strain, and axial strain. The function must rely on the individual helpers to compute and return a list of the eight material properties. If provided with a list of typical test values, it should yield the eight calculated mechanical statistics.

title: Ventilation Heat Exchange
spec: Implement a module with individual functions for analyzing heating, ventilation, and air conditioning systems. Define a separate function for sensible heat transfer, latent heat transfer, total heat transfer, airflow rate in cubic feet per minute, air changes per hour, mixed air temperature, cooling load, and heating load. Include a primary function `ventilation(readings)` that takes a list of variables such as room volume, indoor temperature, outdoor temperature, humidity ratios, and specific volume of air. The entry function should execute all the separate calculation functions and return a list of the eight HVAC metrics. An input list representing a standard room environment should result in the eight calculated energy values.

title: Soil Phase Relationships
spec: Write a script with distinct functions to determine the physical states of soil samples. You need to create separate functions to calculate void ratio, porosity, degree of saturation, water content, bulk unit weight, dry unit weight, saturated unit weight, and specific gravity of soil solids. Provide a main function `soil(sample)` which accepts a list of basic laboratory measurements including the volume of voids, volume of solids, mass of water, mass of solids, total volume, and total mass. This main function should use the eight individual helpers and return a list of the calculated properties. For a sample with known masses and volumes, it should output a list of the eight geotechnical indices.

title: Text Readability Scores
spec: Compute eight simple linguistic metrics for a given paragraph of text. Word count is the number of space separated tokens. Sentence count is the number of periods, exclamation marks, or question marks. Syllable estimate is the total number of vowels. Character count ignores spaces. Average word length is character count divided by word count. Average sentence length is word count divided by sentence count. Vowel density is syllable estimate divided by character count. Reading time estimate is word count divided by two hundred. Create an individual top level function for each of these eight metrics. The main function `readability(text)` returns a list of these eight numbers. Example: for the string 'hello world. it is.' it returns approximately [4, 2, 4, 15, 3.75, 2.0, 0.26, 0.02].

title: Smart Home Automation Rules
spec: Determine the target temperature and lighting settings for eight distinct home modes based on the current outside temperature and time of day. Morning mode sets heating to outside plus five and lights to eighty. Day mode sets cooling to outside minus ten and lights to zero. Evening mode sets heating to outside plus three and lights to sixty. Night mode sets cooling to outside minus five and lights to ten. Away mode sets heating to fifty and lights to zero. Vacation mode sets heating to forty five and lights to random intervals simulated as fifty. Party mode sets cooling to outside minus fifteen and lights to one hundred. Emergency mode sets both to extreme maximums like one hundred. Implement a separate function for each of these eight modes. The entry function `automate(environment)` receives outside temperature and a mode identifier from 1 to 8, calling the appropriate function and returning a tuple of target temperature and light level.

title: Supply Chain Logistics Indicators
spec: Calculate eight logistics indicators for a product inventory. Lead time demand is average daily sales times lead time in days. Safety stock is max daily sales times max lead time minus average sales times average lead time. Reorder point is lead time demand plus safety stock. Economic order quantity is the square root of two times order cost times annual demand divided by holding cost. Average inventory is economic order quantity divided by two plus safety stock. Inventory turnover is annual demand divided by average inventory. Carrying cost is average inventory times holding cost. Stockout cost is stockout probability times annual demand times unit price. Write an individual independent function for evaluating each of these eight indicators. The main function `logistics(metrics)` takes a list of the necessary underlying parameters and returns a list of the eight computed indicators.

title: Hotel Management Dashboard
spec: Evaluate eight performance metrics for a hospitality business. Occupancy rate is rooms sold divided by rooms available. Average daily rate is total room revenue divided by rooms sold. Revenue per available room is total room revenue divided by rooms available. Total revenue is room revenue plus food revenue plus other revenue. Operating expenses is fixed costs plus variable costs per room times rooms sold. Gross operating profit is total revenue minus operating expenses. Profit margin is gross operating profit divided by total revenue. Break even occupancy is fixed costs divided by the difference between average daily rate and variable cost per room. Define a separate function to calculate each of these eight metrics. The entry function `hospitality(data)` receives a list of the base figures and returns a tuple of the eight metrics.

title: Real Estate Valuation Suite
spec: Compute eight investment property metrics. Gross rent multiplier is property price divided by annual rental income. Capitalization rate is net operating income divided by property price. Cash flow is net operating income minus annual debt service. Cash on cash return is cash flow divided by initial cash investment. Operating expense ratio is operating expenses divided by gross operating income. Debt service coverage ratio is net operating income divided by annual debt service. Break even ratio is operating expenses plus debt service divided by gross operating income. Return on equity is cash flow plus principal reduction divided by total equity. Provide an individual top level function for each of these eight calculations. The main function `valuation(figures)` accepts a list of base financial numbers and returns a list of these eight metrics.

title: Video Game Combat Mechanics
spec: Process eight distinct combat calculations in a tactical simulation. Base damage is attacker strength minus defender armor. Critical multiplier is two if the provided random roll is above a threshold else one. Elemental bonus adds twenty percent if attacker element counters defender element. Terrain modifier adds ten percent if attacking from high ground. Flanking bonus adds fifteen percent if attack is from behind. Status effect damage adds five damage per tick of poison. Healing received reduces current wounds by twenty percent of max health. Final damage applies all multipliers and additions to the base damage. Implement a distinct function for each of the eight calculations. The entry function `combat(state)` evaluates these and returns the final damage and the remaining health of the defender as a tuple.

title: Botanical Physiology Simulator
spec: Calculate eight physiological rates for a simulated crop. Photosynthesis rate is light intensity times carbon dioxide level times zero point five. Transpiration rate is temperature times zero point eight minus humidity times zero point two. Root growth rate is soil moisture times zero point three. Leaf expansion rate is photosynthesis rate minus transpiration rate. Nutrient uptake rate is soil fertility times root growth rate. Water stress level is transpiration rate divided by soil moisture. Sunlight stress is zero if light intensity is below one hundred else light minus one hundred. Daily biomass increase is photosynthesis rate plus nutrient uptake minus stress factors. Write a separate top level helper function for each rate. The main function `botany(conditions)` accepts environmental parameters and returns a tuple of the eight simulated rates.

title: Employee Payroll Processor
spec: Calculate eight components of an employee paycheck. Regular pay is hours up to forty times hourly rate. Overtime pay is hours over forty times hourly rate times one point five. Gross pay is regular plus overtime pay. Federal income tax is gross pay times twelve percent. State income tax is gross pay times five percent. Social security deduction is gross pay times six point two percent. Medicare deduction is gross pay times one point four five percent. Net pay is gross pay minus all taxes and deductions. Define an independent function for each of these eight paycheck components. The entry function `payroll(data)` receives a list with hours worked and hourly rate, returning a list containing regular pay, overtime, gross pay, the four deductions, and net pay. Example: [40, 10] yields [400, 0, 400, 48, 20, 24.8, 5.8, 301.4].

title: Commercial Aviation Planner
spec: Compute eight flight planning metrics for a commercial aircraft. Total passenger weight is number of passengers times eighty five kilograms. Total cargo weight is number of bags times twenty kilograms. Zero fuel weight is empty weight plus passenger and cargo weight. Required fuel is flight duration in hours times fuel burn rate plus reserve fuel. Takeoff weight is zero fuel weight plus required fuel. Takeoff distance is takeoff weight times zero point zero two. Cruise speed is engine thrust minus drag divided by weight factor. Descent time is cruise altitude divided by descent rate. Create an individual function for each of these eight flight metrics. The main function `aviation(parameters)` takes a list of flight variables and returns a tuple of the eight computed results.

title: Pastry Dough Ratios
spec: Calculate eight ingredient weights in grams for a bread recipe based on the total flour weight. Water weight is seventy percent of flour weight. Salt weight is two percent. Fresh yeast is three percent. Active dry yeast is one percent. Sugar weight is five percent. Butter weight is ten percent. Milk powder is four percent. Sourdough starter is twenty percent. Implement a separate top level function to calculate each of these eight ingredient weights. The entry function `bake(flour)` takes a single number representing the flour weight in grams and returns a tuple of the eight calculated ingredient weights in the order listed. Example: inputting 1000 returns (700.0, 20.0, 30.0, 10.0, 50.0, 100.0, 40.0, 200.0).

title: Network Packet Analyzer
spec: Extract and calculate eight properties from a raw string representing a network packet header. Version is the first character converted to an integer. Header length is the second character times four. Type of service is the third and fourth characters parsed as hex. Total length is the fifth through eighth characters parsed as hex. Identification is the next four characters parsed as hex. Time to live is the thirteenth and fourteenth characters parsed as hex. Protocol is the fifteenth and sixteenth characters parsed as hex. Payload size is total length minus header length. Write a separate independent function for evaluating each of these eight properties. The entry function `packet(data)` accepts the packet hex string and returns a list of these eight numerical properties.

title: Cryptocurrency Portfolio Tracker
spec: Calculate eight metrics for a digital asset portfolio. Total value is coin amount times current price. Profit or loss is total value minus initial investment. Return on investment is profit divided by initial investment. Moving average is the sum of the last seven daily prices divided by seven. Volatility is the highest price minus the lowest price in the week. Market dominance is total value divided by total market cap. Slippage estimate is order size times zero point zero one percent. Liquidation price is entry price minus collateral divided by leverage. Define an individual standalone function for each of these eight metrics. The main function `crypto(portfolio)` receives a list of raw numbers and returns a list of the eight calculated values.

title: Smart Grid Energy Distributer
spec: Compute eight energy distribution metrics for a local power grid. Solar production is panel area times sunlight intensity times efficiency. Wind production is turbine count times wind speed squared times zero point five. Grid import is target demand minus local production if positive else zero. Battery charge is excess production if local exceeds demand else zero. Grid export is excess production minus battery capacity if positive else zero. Total consumption is target demand plus charging energy. Transmission loss is total consumption times zero point zero three. Net carbon offset is renewable production minus grid import times zero point four. Create a separate function for each of the eight metrics. The entry function `grid(data)` takes the environmental inputs and returns a tuple of the eight metrics.

title: Marine Biology Coral Bleaching
spec: Calculate eight stress indicators for a coral reef system. Temperature stress is water temperature minus baseline threshold. Acidity stress is baseline ph minus current ph times ten. Pollution level is nitrate concentration plus phosphate concentration. Sedimentation rate is turbidity minus five. Sunlight exposure is hours of daylight above intensity threshold. Symbiodinium loss is temperature stress times acidity stress. Calcification rate is one divided by acidity stress. Overall bleaching risk is the sum of all stress factors divided by calcification rate. Implement an individual top level function for each of the eight indicators. The main function `coral(metrics)` receives a list of environmental readings and returns a tuple of these eight calculated indicators.

title: Athletic Conditioning Targets
spec: Determine eight training parameters for an athlete. Maximum heart rate is two hundred twenty minus age. Target aerobic zone is max heart rate times zero point seven. Target anaerobic zone is max heart rate times zero point eight five. Daily calorie burn is resting metabolic rate times activity multiplier. Protein requirement is body weight in kilograms times one point six. Water requirement is body weight in kilograms times zero point zero three plus sweat loss. Recovery time in hours is workout duration times zero point two plus fatigue level. Sleep requirement is eight plus recovery time divided by five. Write a distinct function for each of these eight parameters. The entry function `training(profile)` accepts a list of physical inputs and returns a tuple of the eight targets.

title: Motorsport Telemetry Analyzer
spec: Calculate eight telemetry metrics from a race car sensor array. Wheel slip ratio is wheel speed minus ground speed divided by ground speed. Engine load is current rpm divided by max rpm. Brake temperature increase is braking force times duration times friction coefficient. Tire wear is cornering force plus wheel slip ratio times distance. Aerodynamic downforce is velocity squared times drag coefficient times zero point five. Fuel consumption rate is engine load times throttle position. Lateral acceleration is velocity squared divided by turning radius. Suspension travel is track bumpiness times spring stiffness. Define an individual function for evaluating each of these eight metrics. The main function `telemetry(sensors)` takes a list of raw sensor readings and returns a list of the eight computed metrics.

title: E-Commerce Customer Profiler
spec: Compute eight customer engagement metrics for an online store. Purchase frequency is total orders divided by account age in months. Average order value is total spent divided by total orders. Customer lifetime value is purchase frequency times average order value times expected lifespan. Cart abandonment rate is abandoned carts divided by total carts. Return rate is returned items divided by total items bought. Discount usage is discounted items divided by total items. Review ratio is reviews written divided by total orders. Engagement score is login frequency plus review ratio minus return rate. Create a separate top level function for each of these eight metrics. The entry function `customer(data)` accepts the raw totals as a list and returns a tuple of the eight computed metrics.

title: Factory Machinery Maintenance
spec: Evaluate eight machine health indicators on a manufacturing floor. Vibration severity is amplitude times frequency. Temperature anomaly is current temp minus normal operating temp. Lubrication degradation is operating hours times friction coefficient. Motor current draw is baseline current plus load factor. Belt tension loss is initial tension minus current tension. Bearing wear is vibration severity plus temperature anomaly times age. Output efficiency is actual production divided by expected production. Maintenance priority is the sum of wear and degradation divided by output efficiency. Implement an individual independent function for each of the eight indicators. The main function `machinery(sensors)` receives a list of sensor data and returns a list of the eight health scores.

title: Exoplanet Habitability Index
spec: Calculate eight viability metrics for a candidate exoplanet. Surface gravity is mass divided by radius squared. Escape velocity is the square root of two times gravity times radius. Atmospheric pressure is base pressure times temperature divided by volume. Habitable zone distance is star luminosity divided by distance squared. Radiation exposure is star flare rate divided by magnetic field strength. Temperature stability is max temp minus min temp. Water availability is ice mass plus liquid mass. Colonization score is water availability plus temperature stability divided by radiation exposure. Write a distinct function for each of these eight metrics. The entry function `exoplanet(data)` accepts the astronomical inputs and returns a tuple of the eight calculated metrics.

title: Wildlife Population Dynamics
spec: Compute eight demographic parameters for a protected animal species. Birth rate is number of mature females times average litter size. Death rate is natural mortality plus predation plus disease. Net migration is immigrants minus emigrants. Population growth is birth rate minus death rate plus net migration. Carrying capacity usage is current population divided by habitat size. Resource competition is population growth times carrying capacity usage. Genetic diversity index is number of distinct breeding pairs divided by total population. Extinction risk is death rate divided by birth rate times resource competition. Define a separate standalone function for evaluating each of these eight parameters. The main function `wildlife(census)` takes the field data and returns a list of the eight calculated metrics.

title: Guitar Chord Fret Spans
spec: Write a module with a standalone function for each of ten guitar chord types that computes the maximum fret span given a base fret position. Major adds 3 to the base. Minor adds 4. Seventh adds 5. Augmented adds 4 and multiplies by 2. Diminished adds 3 and divides by 2. Suspended second adds 5 and subtracts 1. Suspended fourth adds 6. Major seventh adds 4 and adds the base again. Minor seventh adds 5 and subtracts 2. Power chord adds 2 and multiplies by 3. Include an entry function `spans(base)` that calls all ten functions and returns a list of the spans. For an input of 4, it returns [7, 8, 9, 16, 3.5, 8, 10, 12, 7, 18].

title: Origami Fold Angles
spec: Implement a separate helper for each of ten origami fold types to compute the resulting paper thickness angle given an initial crease angle. Valley fold halves the angle. Mountain fold halves the angle and adds 10. Petal fold divides by 3. Squash fold divides by 4 and adds 5. Reverse fold subtracts 15 and halves the remainder. Rabbit ear divides by 3 and adds 12. Crimp fold subtracts 20 and divides by 2. Sink fold divides by 5. Pleat fold multiplies by 2 and divides by 3. Waterbomb fold divides by 6 and adds 2. spec: Create an individual calculator for each of ten knitting stitch types to estimate millimeter yarn usage given a base tension value. Knit stitch uses tension times 2.5. Purl stitch uses tension times 2.6. Slip stitch uses tension times 1.2. Yarn over uses tension times 3.1. Knit two together uses tension times 4.0. Purl two together uses tension times 4.2. title: Sailing Knot Strengths
spec: Develop a module containing a distinct function for each of ten sailing knots to calculate breaking strength retention given a line strength. Bowline retains 60 percent. Clove hitch retains 65 percent. Square knot retains 45 percent. Figure eight retains 80 percent. Sheet bend retains 55 percent. Timber hitch retains 70 percent. Taut line hitch retains 50 percent. Round turn retains 75 percent. Fisherman knot retains 68 percent. Carrick bend retains 85 percent. Create an entry function `strengths(line)` returning the retained strengths as a list. For a line of 100, returns [60, 65, 45, 80, 55, 70, 50, 75, 68, 85].

title: Tower Crane Load Limits
spec: Write a dedicated function for each of ten crane configurations that calculates the maximum load limit given a counterweight mass. Hammerhead crane takes mass times 2. Luffing jib takes mass times 1.5. Derrick crane takes mass times 3. Crawler crane takes mass times 2.5. Mobile crane takes mass times 1.8. Gantry crane takes mass times 4. Jib crane takes mass times 1.2. Overhead crane takes mass times 5. Telescopic crane takes mass times 1.4. Floating crane takes mass times 6. Include an entry function `limits(mass)` returning the ten load limits. For mass of 10, returns [20, 15, 30, 25, 18, 40, 12, 50, 14, 60].

title: Locomotive Traction Weights
spec: Write a specific function for each of ten steam locomotive wheel arrangements that outputs a traction factor based on a boiler pressure. Pacific type requires pressure times 0.6. Mikado requires pressure times 0.8. Consolidation requires pressure times 0.9. Ten wheeler requires pressure times 0.5. Hudson requires pressure times 0.55. Northern requires pressure times 0.7. Decapod requires pressure times 1.0. Santa fe requires pressure times 1.1. Texas requires pressure times 1.2. Challenger requires pressure times 1.4. Provide an entry function `traction(pressure)` that aggregates the results of all ten functions in a list. For pressure of 100, returns [60, 80, 90, 50, 55, 70, 100, 110, 120, 140].

title: Sewing Thread Consumptions
spec: Provide an individual function for each of ten sewing machine stitches estimating thread consumption given a seam length. Straight stitch is length times 2. Zigzag stitch is length times 3. Overlock is length times 4. Blind hem is length times 2.5. Buttonhole is length times 5. Stretch stitch is length times 3.5. Triple straight is length times 3. Feather stitch is length times 4.5. Blanket stitch is length times 3.8. Basting stitch is length times 1.5. Write an entry function `consumption(length)` that calls them all and returns a list. For length of 10, returns [20, 30, 40, 25, 50, 35, 30, 45, 38, 15].

title: Morse Code Timings
spec: Create a module with a standalone function for each of ten morse code elements to calculate duration given a base unit in milliseconds. Dot duration equals 1 unit. Dash equals 3 units. Intra character gap equals 1 unit. Short gap equals 3 units. Medium gap equals 7 units. Long gap equals 10 units. Extra long gap equals 14 units. Prosign gap equals 5 units. Word gap equals 7 units. Sentence gap equals 15 units. Include an entry function `timing(unit)` that returns the ten durations as a list. For unit of 50, returns [50, 150, 50, 150, 350, 500, 700, 250, 350, 750].

title: Lock Tumbler Complexity
spec: Write a distinct function for each of ten security pin types that computes a complexity score based on a cut depth. Standard pin adds 2 to depth. Spool pin multiplies depth by 2. Serrated pin multiplies depth by 3 and subtracts 1. Mushroom pin multiplies depth by 2.5. Torpedo pin adds 5 and multiplies by 2. T pin adds 3 and multiplies by 1.5. Barrel pin multiplies depth by 2.8. Gin spool adds 4 and multiplies by 3. Corrugated pin multiplies depth by 4. Bump pin subtracts 1 and multiplies by 2. Provide an entry function `complexity(depth)` returning all ten scores. For depth of 10, returns [12, 20, 29, 25, 30, 19.5, 28, 42, 40, 18].

title: Helicopter Lift Capacities
spec: Implement a separate function for each of ten helicopter rotor types to calculate lift force given an engine horsepower. Main rotor takes horsepower times 4. Tail rotor takes horsepower times 0.5. Tandem rotors take horsepower times 7. Coaxial rotors take horsepower times 5. Intermeshing rotors take horsepower times 6. Tiltrotor takes horsepower times 4.5. Notar takes horsepower times 0.4. Fenestron takes horsepower times 0.6. Tip jet takes horsepower times 3. Synchropter takes horsepower times 5.5. Provide an entry function `lift(horsepower)` yielding a list of the ten calculated forces. For horsepower of 100, returns [400, 50, 700, 500, 600, 450, 40, 60, 300, 550].

spec: Develop an individual function for each of ten footwear styles to estimate shoe volume given a foot length. Oxford style multiplies length by 3. Derby multiplies length by 3.2. Loafer multiplies length by 2.8. Chelsea boot multiplies length by 3.5. Chukka boot multiplies length by 3.4. Sneaker multiplies length by 3.1. Sandal multiplies length by 2.5. spec: Write a dedicated function for each of ten equine coat color genes that calculates a manifestation score based on a base pedigree value. Bay gene adds 50. Black gene multiplies by 1.2. Chestnut gene adds 30 and multiplies by 2. Grey gene multiplies by 3. Roan gene adds 40 and multiplies by 1.5. Dun gene multiplies by 2.5. Cream gene adds 20. Pearl gene adds 15 and multiplies by 2. Champagne gene multiplies by 2.2. Silver dapple adds 25 and multiplies by 1.8. Include an entry function `scores(pedigree)` yielding the ten scores. title: Snowboard Flex Ratings
spec: Implement a specific function for each of ten snowboard camber profiles to evaluate a stiffness index given a base rider weight. Traditional camber adds 20 to weight. Rocker profile subtracts 10. Flat profile adds 5. Hybrid camber adds 15. Hybrid rocker adds 8. S rocker adds 12. Flat to rocker adds 3. Camber rocker camber adds 18. Powder rocker subtracts 5. Asymmetrical adds 10. Write an entry function `stiffness(weight)` returning all ten indices in a list. For weight of 100, returns [120, 90, 105, 115, 108, 112, 103, 118, 95, 110].

title: Microphone Attenuation Angles
spec: Provide a distinct function for each of ten microphone polar patterns computing off axis attenuation in decibels given an angle from the source. Omnidirectional takes angle times 0. Cardioid takes angle times 0.1. Supercardioid takes angle times 0.15. Hypercardioid takes angle times 0.18. Figure eight takes angle times 0.2. Subcardioid takes angle times 0.05. Shotgun takes angle times 0.25. Lobar takes angle times 0.3. Boundary takes angle times 0.08. Hemispherical takes angle times 0.02. Cello requires gauge times 60. Double bass requires gauge times 100. Classical guitar requires gauge times 40. Acoustic guitar requires gauge times 80. Electric guitar requires gauge times 50. Mandolin requires gauge times 45. Banjo requires gauge times 25. Ukulele requires gauge times 15. Create an entry function `tension(gauge)` yielding the ten amounts in a list. Orthoscopic takes focal length times 0.4. Kellner takes focal length times 0.45. Erfle takes focal length times 0.6. Nagler takes focal length times 0.8. Ethos takes focal length times 1.0. title: Forklift Clearance Radii
spec: Create a dedicated function for each of ten warehouse forklift types computing the minimum aisle clearance given a wheelbase dimension. Counterbalance forklift multiplies wheelbase by 2. Reach truck multiplies wheelbase by 1.5. Pallet jack multiplies wheelbase by 1.2. Order picker multiplies wheelbase by 1.4. Turret truck multiplies wheelbase by 1.8. Straddle carrier multiplies wheelbase by 3. Side loader multiplies wheelbase by 2.5. Articulated forklift multiplies wheelbase by 1.3. Walkie stacker multiplies wheelbase by 1.1. spec: Write a distinct function for each of ten calligraphy scripts to calculate ink flow rate given a nib width. Italic script uses width times 2. Copperplate uses width times 3. Per fess takes area divided by 2. Per bend takes area divided by 2. Per chevron takes area divided by 3. Quarterly takes area divided by 4. Saltire takes area divided by 4. Bass drum requires 1500 divided by diameter. Tom tom requires 2400 divided by diameter. Floor tom requires 1800 divided by diameter. Bongo requires 4000 divided by diameter. title: Billiard Shot Rebounds
spec: Implement a specific function for each of ten billiard shot techniques evaluating the cue ball rebound speed given an initial speed. Follow shot retains 90 percent. Draw shot retains 80 percent. Stun shot retains 10 percent. Left english retains 85 percent. Right english retains 85 percent. Masse retains 40 percent. Jump shot retains 60 percent. Swerve retains 70 percent. Drag shot retains 50 percent. Force follow retains 95 percent. Include an entry function `rebound(speed)` returning the ten speeds.
