title: Chainsaw Drive Links
spec: Write a dedicated function for each of ten chainsaw chain pitches computing the number of drive links required given a bar length in inches. Quarter inch pitch takes length times 4. Three eighths low profile takes length times 3. Point three two five pitch takes length times 3.5. Three eighths standard takes length times 2.8. Point four zero four pitch takes length times 2.5. Half inch pitch takes length times 2. Three quarter inch takes length times 1.5. Harvester pitch takes length times 2.2. Micro chisel takes length times 3.2. Semi chisel takes length times 3.4. Create an entry function `links(length)` yielding all ten link counts in a list. For length of 20, returns [80, 60, 70, 56, 50, 40, 30, 44, 64, 68].

title: Camera Lens Optical Parameters
spec: Build a modular suite offering distinct functions to compute various optical lens properties given a focal length and aperture diameter. Write individual functions to calculate the f number, diopter power, entrance pupil area, hyperfocal distance assuming a fixed circle of confusion, depth of field front limit, depth of field rear limit, total depth of field, field of view angle for a standard sensor, and the optical magnification factor. Finally, write an entry function `inspect(lenses)` that takes a list of focal length and aperture diameter pairs and returns a list of tuples containing all nine computed properties for each lens. For example, an input of a list containing a focal length of fifty and aperture of twenty five should yield a tuple starting with an f number of two and a diopter of twenty.

title: Regional Tax Breakdown Calculators
spec: Create a library of individual functions to calculate different components of a paycheck deduction given a gross salary. You must include separate calculators for federal income tax at a flat rate, state tax with a fixed deduction, local municipality tax, social security contribution, medicare premium, health insurance base premium, retirement matching contribution, union dues, and the final net take home pay which subtracts all deductions. Include an entry function `process(salaries)` that iterates over a list of gross salaries and applies all nine calculators, returning a list of net pay results. For an input of one thousand, the output list might contain seven hundred depending on the flat rates chosen.

title: Blood Lab Range Evaluator Suite
spec: Design a module with separate functions to evaluate individual blood test results against standard healthy ranges, returning a boolean for each. Implement distinct evaluators for hematocrit percentage, hemoglobin concentration, red blood cell count, white blood cell count, mean corpuscular volume, platelet count, fasting blood glucose, serum calcium, and blood urea nitrogen. Each function should accept a single numerical test result. Provide a main function `screen(patients)` that takes a list of lists containing the nine test values for each patient. It should return a list of lists of booleans indicating normal results. An input list for one patient with all ideal values should return a list of nine true values.

title: Swimming Pool Maintenance Tools
spec: Write a suite of distinct functions to calculate required swimming pool chemical and physical adjustments given the pool volume in gallons. Include individual calculations for the turnover rate in hours, required filter pump flow rate, liquid chlorine ounces needed to reach target parts per million, muriatic acid ounces for ph reduction, baking soda pounds for alkalinity increase, calcium chloride amounts, cyanuric acid stabilizer pounds, maximum bather load, and winterizing antifreeze gallons. Implement an entry function `adjust(volumes)` that accepts a list of pool volumes and returns a list of tuples containing all nine maintenance values. An input of ten thousand gallons should return a tuple of nine proportionate calculated values.

title: E-commerce Shipping Fee Components
spec: Build a set of separate functions to determine individual shipping fee components for a package given its weight and travel distance. Create distinct rules for the base zone rate, overweight surcharge, oversized volume fee, fragile handling fee, rural delivery surcharge, fuel surcharge percentage, signature confirmation flat fee, holiday peak season multiplier, and the total final shipping cost. Define an entry function `quote(packages)` that takes a list of weight and distance pairs and returns a list of the final calculated shipping costs. For a ten pound package traveling five hundred miles, the output might be thirty five point five zero.

title: Audio Synthesizer Envelope Metrics
spec: Implement a module with individual functions to calculate parameters for an audio synthesizer patch given a base frequency and tempo. Include separate functions to determine the oscillator wavelength, low frequency oscillator rate in hertz, attack time in milliseconds, decay curve duration, sustain level percentage, release time in milliseconds, filter cutoff frequency, resonance peak amplitude, and the master output gain. Write a main function `synthesize(patches)` that takes a list of frequency and tempo pairs, evaluates all nine parameters, and returns a list of tuples. An input pair of four hundred forty hertz and one hundred twenty beats per minute should return a tuple of the nine computed synthesizer metrics.

title: Geotechnical Earth Mechanics
spec: Create a library of distinct functions to calculate soil mechanics properties given the mass of solids, mass of water, and total volume. Provide individual calculators for water content, soil void ratio, porosity percentage, degree of saturation, dry unit weight, bulk unit weight, saturated unit weight, submerged unit weight, and the estimated specific gravity of the soil solids. Write an entry function `survey(samples)` that processes a list of mass and volume triplets, applying the nine calculations to each. It should return a list of tuples containing the nine geotechnical properties. For inputs of one hundred grams of solids, twenty grams of water, and sixty cubic centimeters, the output should reflect standard soil metrics.

title: Video Transcoding Metric Estimators
spec: Develop a module offering individual functions to estimate video transcoding metrics given a frame count, width, and height. Create separate calculations for the total pixel count per frame, uncompressed frame size in bytes, target compressed bitrate, estimated file size per minute, streaming bandwidth requirement, chunk size for adaptive streaming, peak memory usage during encoding, estimated render time, and the aspect ratio multiplier. Include a driver function `estimate(videos)` that takes a list of frame count, width, and height triplets and returns a list of tuples containing all nine metrics. For a standard high definition video of sixty frames, the output tuple will contain the corresponding byte and time estimates.

title: Heavy Lifting Rigging Parameters
spec: Design a suite of separate functions to determine the safe working loads for crane rigging given a total payload weight and boom angle. Include distinct functions for the vertical tension per sling leg, angled tension multiplier, master link load, shackle capacity requirement, boom radius reach, load moment indicator value, maximum tip height, block weight deduction, and the final net lift capacity. Provide an entry function `plan(lifts)` that takes a list of weight and angle pairs, evaluates all nine functions, and returns a list of tuples with the rigging parameters. An input of five thousand pounds at forty five degrees should output the nine respective load limits.

title: Photography Print Framing Dimensions
spec: Write individual functions to calculate the dimensions needed to frame a fine art photography print given the image width and height. Implement separate calculations for the image aspect ratio, required mat board width, required mat board height, acrylic glazing area, backing board perimeter, inner frame opening, outer frame dimensions, hanging wire length, and the total wall space square footage. Create an entry function `frame(prints)` that takes a list of width and height pairs and returns a list of tuples holding the nine framing measurements. An eight by ten input should return a tuple including a mat size of twelve by fourteen and a corresponding wire length.

title: Aerospace Propulsion Equations
spec: Build a module of distinct functions to calculate theoretical rocket engine performance given the chamber pressure and throat area. Provide separate calculators for the mass flow rate, exhaust velocity, exit area for optimal expansion, thrust produced, specific impulse, characteristic velocity, thrust coefficient, nozzle expansion ratio, and total propellant consumed per second. Write an entry function `simulate(engines)` that accepts a list of pressure and area pairs and returns a list of tuples containing all nine performance metrics. An input of one thousand kilopascals and zero point five square meters should yield a tuple of the nine computed rocket parameters.

title: Nutritional Meal Breakdown Suite
spec: Implement a set of individual functions to calculate the caloric and nutritional breakdown of a meal given the grams of protein, carbohydrates, and fats. Include separate functions to calculate the calories from protein, calories from carbohydrates, calories from fats, total caloric yield, protein percentage, carbohydrate percentage, fat percentage, estimated fiber content, and a thermic effect of food deduction. Define a main function `profile(meals)` that processes a list of protein, carbohydrate, and fat triplets. It should return a list of tuples containing the nine calculated dietary metrics. An input of thirty, forty, and ten grams respectively should return a tuple starting with one hundred twenty protein calories.

title: Farm Irrigation Planning Formulas
spec: Create a library of separate functions to plan agricultural irrigation given the soil moisture deficit and crop acreage. Write individual calculations for the crop evapotranspiration rate, root zone depth limit, wetted area percentage, required flow rate in gallons per minute, total irrigation run time, gross water application volume, leaching requirement for salt management, pump energy cost, and the total water volume in acre feet. Include an entry function `schedule(fields)` that accepts a list of deficit and acreage pairs, returning a list of tuples with all nine irrigation metrics. For a deficit of two inches on five acres, the output tuple will provide the nine watering parameters.

title: Miniature Wargame Combat Resolution
spec: Develop a module with distinct functions to resolve combat in a tabletop game given an attacker strength and defender armor rating. Implement separate functions to calculate the base physical damage, weapon type multiplier, armor mitigation amount, terrain defense bonus, critical hit probability, evasion dodge chance, morale penalty for the defender, stamina cost for the attacker, and the final net damage dealt. Write a driver function `resolve(combats)` that takes a list of strength and armor pairs and returns a list of the final net damage integers. An attacker with twenty strength against a defender with five armor might return a final damage of fifteen.

title: Stock Options Pricing Greeks
spec: Design a suite of individual functions to calculate financial option metrics given a stock price and strike price. Provide separate calculations for the intrinsic value, remaining time value, estimated delta sensitivity, gamma curvature, theta time decay, vega volatility impact, rho interest rate sensitivity, theoretical option premium, and the breakeven stock price. Create an entry function `price(options)` that takes a list of stock and strike price pairs and returns a list of tuples holding the nine financial metrics. For a stock at fifty and a strike at fifty five, the output tuple should reflect an intrinsic value of zero and the other eight calculated metrics.

title: Cycling Wheel Mechanics
spec: Write a modular set of distinct functions to evaluate the physics of a bicycle wheel given its radius and mass. Include individual calculations for the rotational moment of inertia, gyroscopic torque at speed, radial stiffness factor, lateral flex resistance, aerodynamic drag frontal area, rolling resistance coefficient, ground contact patch length, spoke tension requirement, and the total power loss in watts. Define an entry function `evaluate(wheels)` that accepts a list of radius and mass pairs and returns a list of tuples containing all nine physical properties. A standard wheel radius of three hundred millimeters and mass of one kilogram should return the nine respective mechanical values.

title: Cloud Formation Altitude Predictors
spec: Build a library of separate functions to calculate atmospheric cloud properties given the surface temperature and dewpoint. Provide distinct calculators for the temperature dewpoint spread, lifting condensation level altitude, estimated wet bulb temperature, relative humidity percentage, actual vapor pressure, saturation vapor pressure, atmospheric mixing ratio, air parcel density, and the convective available potential energy indicator. Write an entry function `forecast(conditions)` that processes a list of temperature and dewpoint pairs, returning a list of tuples with the nine meteorological metrics. An input of twenty five degrees and a dewpoint of fifteen should yield a tuple starting with a spread of ten degrees.

title: Donut Shape Geometry Suite
spec: Implement a suite of individual functions to compute the geometric properties of a torus given its major and minor radii. Create separate calculations for the overall volume, total surface area, cross sectional area, bounding box volume, moment of inertia around the vertical axis, moment of inertia around the horizontal axis, innermost circumference, outermost circumference, and the ratio of the major to minor radius. Define a driver function `measure(shapes)` that takes a list of major and minor radii pairs and returns a list of tuples containing all nine geometric properties. An input of a major radius of ten and minor radius of three should return a tuple with the nine computed measurements.
